nodes.label: adsb.lol
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered community ADS-B aggregator, free and no API key; shows LADD/military aircraft that commercial trackers hide.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers / D1
nodes.rationale: Planned later; currently a non-goal (single Node process target).

nodes.label: dbFlags Bitfield
nodes.rationale: Bit 1 = military, bit 8 = LADD, bit 4 = PIA (not tracked).

nodes.label: FAA Limiting Aircraft Data Displayed List
nodes.norm_label: faa limiting aircraft data displayed list

nodes.label: Live State
nodes.rationale: In-memory store keyed by hex with 30-minute trails; entries unseen for 120 s are removed.

nodes.label: Node 24 + TypeScript Type Stripping
nodes.rationale: No build step for the server; tsc used for type checking only.

nodes.label: OpenSky Aircraft Database
nodes.rationale: adsb.lol responses carry no owner/operator info, so OpenSky metadata CSV is used for government detection; re-downloaded when older than 30 days.

nodes.label: PIA (Privacy ICAO Address)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly not tracked; listed as a non-goal.

nodes.label: Known Limits
nodes.rationale: Government detection is heuristic; LADD is US-only; coverage limited to adsb.lol feeders and many military aircraft don't transmit ADS-B.

nodes.label: Classifier
nodes.rationale: Aircraft may belong to multiple categories; civil aircraft with no category are dropped.

nodes.label: Exclusion Keywords
nodes.rationale: Cut obvious false positives in keyword-based government matching.

nodes.label: Government Index
nodes.rationale: Built by stream-parsing the ~100 MB OpenSky CSV and keeping only matches in memory to limit memory use; stores operator, owner, reason.

nodes.label: API Input Validation
nodes.rationale: hex 6 hex chars (~ prefix allowed), from<to with max 7-day window, cat subset, row limits.

nodes.label: Poller
nodes.rationale: One global request every 20 s keeps load low; exponential backoff (cap 5 min) on 429/5xx/network errors respects dynamic rate limits.

nodes.label: One Position Per Aircraft Per Minute
nodes.norm_label: one position per aircraft per minute
nodes.rationale: Tracked via aircraft.last_pos_ts so it survives restarts; keeps write volume low, including for a future Cloudflare Workers/D1 port.

nodes.label: Single-Process Architecture
nodes.rationale: Poller, classifier, live state, history, API and static frontend in one Node process.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Records (docs/adr/)
nodes.rationale: Contradictions with an existing ADR must be surfaced explicitly, not silently overridden.

nodes.label: /domain-modeling skill
nodes.rationale: Creates glossary and ADR files lazily when terms/decisions get resolved; absence is not flagged.

nodes.label: GLOSSARY.md
nodes.rationale: Outputs must use glossary vocabulary; missing terms signal invented language or a real gap.

nodes.label: Blocking via native issue dependencies
nodes.rationale: Native dependencies are the canonical UI-visible representation; fallback is a 'Blocked by' line.

nodes.label: Workflow: Conventional Commits, small commits, push to origin main
nodes.norm_label: workflow: conventional commits, small commits, push to origin main
nodes.rationale: Commit small and often; no AI attribution trailers in commits or PRs.
